evidence.note: Trains a reinforcement-learned teacher model that is given the solution and rewarded for producing explanations that help a student model understand it, outperforming distillation pipelines built from much larger models.
evidence.title: Reinforcement Learning Teachers of Test Time Scaling

evidence.note: Under a fixed sampling-compute budget, synthetic reasoning data generated by sampling many solutions from a smaller, weaker model trains better reasoners than fewer solutions from a larger, stronger one.
evidence.title: Smaller, Weaker, Yet Better: Training LLM Reasoners via Compute-Optimal Sampling

evidence.note: QUTE is an early-exit-assisted ensemble architecture that quantifies predictive uncertainty in KB-sized TinyML classifiers within a single forward pass, for on-device monitoring without labels.
evidence.title: QUTE: Quantifying Uncertainty in TinyML models with Early-exit-assisted ensembles for model-monitoring

evidence.note: Studies how distillation during LLM pretraining improves test-time scaling but impairs in-context learning (via induction heads), explained through a bigram-model sandbox.
evidence.title: Distilled Pretraining: A modern lens of Data, In-Context Learning and Test-Time Scaling

evidence.note: Analyzes how quantization, distillation, and pruning affect the reasoning versus memorization abilities of large reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1, and proposes protecting a small subset of weights to recover accuracy under quantization.
evidence.title: When Reasoning Meets Compression: Understanding the Effects of LLMs Compression on Large Reasoning Models
